args.sql: SELECT invoice, account, po_number, ROUND(amount,2) AS amount FROM erp_vend_trans WHERE invoice='TWINV-303'

args.subject: PO reference needed for invoice TWINV-303
args.body: Hello — invoice TWINV-303 reached us without a purchase order reference, so we cannot match or schedule it. Please confirm the PO number this invoice was raised against. Thank you, Contoso AP
